_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move plus the 2026-08-12 SolTrans corpus addition, both pending the next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The 2026-08-10 refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. Regenerate these artifacts at the next promoted eval run and remove these entries. Superseded and extended 2026-08-12: adding SolTrans (Solano County Transit, four documents, 20 chunks) rebound corpus_version 35ec70d6359d to a68e77ff4673. This is a real corpus change, not just metadata, so these three artifacts now describe a corpus that is missing an agency until the next promoted live run regenerates them. Regenerate and remove these entries then.
